insight: Created and open-sourced by Daily, the WebRTC video-API company, under a permissive BSD-2-Clause license.
name: Pipecat
tagline: Open-source framework for real-time voice and multimodal AI agents.
description: Pipecat is a Python framework for building voice and multimodal conversational agents that can listen, speak, and see in real time. It orchestrates streaming speech-to-text, an LLM, and text-to-speech into one low-latency pipeline, wiring together 40+ AI services with no vendor lock-in. Client SDKs cover JavaScript, React, React Native, Swift, Kotlin, C++, and ESP32, and Pipecat Cloud offers managed hosting at scale.

modelSupport.notes: Vendor-neutral; mixes and matches 40+ STT, LLM, and TTS providers in a pipeline.

edge: Open-source and vendor-neutral, it wires 40+ STT, LLM, and TTS services into one low-latency pipeline — unlike single-vendor voice-agent platforms.
